sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy remains the solitary pillar of sustained market strength with an exceptional 0.95 momentum score, while Real Estate and Utilities experience sharp multi-session rank deteriorations.

Market breadth is exceptionally narrow, with only 1 of 11 sectors exhibiting all-green performance across all timeframes. Energy continues to dominate the top spot across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons, followed by Technology (0.700 momentum) and Healthcare (0.717 momentum) near the top of the leaderboards. 

Meanwhile, rate-sensitive and defensive groups are fading or splitting. Real Estate fell 3 spots over the last five sessions to rank 8, while Utilities dropped to rank 10 with a market-low momentum score of 0.067. Pockets of rotation are surfacing in Healthcare, Financials, and Consumer Defensive, all edging up 1 spot despite overall defensive weakness elsewhere.

## Strength
- Energy is the sole all-green sector across week, month, quarter, half-year, and YTD timeframes, maintaining a leading 0.950 momentum score.
- Sustained leadership remains confined to Energy, which is the only group holding a top-3 rank across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month evaluation windows.
- Technology maintains high-level stability, holding the rank 2 spot with a 0.700 momentum score.

## Movers & Momentum
- Real Estate suffered the sharpest five-session deterioration, sliding 3 spots down to rank 8 with a 0.333 momentum score.
- Four sectors gained 1 spot over the last five sessions: Communication Services (rank 9, 0.633 momentum), Consumer Defensive (rank 7, 0.417 momentum), Financials (rank 5, 0.667 momentum), and Healthcare (rank 6, 0.717 momentum).
- Utilities anchors the bottom of momentum rankings at 0.067 (down 1 spot to rank 10), closely followed by Consumer Cyclical at 0.150 (rank 11).

## Divergences
- Industrials exhibits a pronounced divergence between historical performance and current momentum, maintaining a solid rank 4 position despite a depressed 0.300 momentum score.
- Communication Services holds an elevated 0.633 momentum score despite sitting deep in the lower tier at rank 9.
- No sectors currently register as fragile all-green, reflecting an environment where broad-based multi-timeframe strength has completely contracted into a single group.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and Marine Shipping maintain dominant momentum while defensive retail rotates higher and metals alongside clean energy suffer sharp rank deterioration.

Market leadership remains heavily concentrated, with just 14 of 144 groups qualifying as all-green. Traditional energy dominates the top tier, led by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.980, rank 2 YTD) and Oil & Gas Integrated (momentum 0.923, rank 7 YTD), alongside structural strength in Marine Shipping (momentum 0.959). At the same time, Diagnostics & Research is accelerating rapidly, jumping 23 spots to rank 49 with a 0.88 momentum score.

Rotation is hitting materials and alternative energy hardest, evidenced by steep five-day rank declines in Coking Coal (-46 spots to 92), Uranium (-38 spots to 105), and Utilities - Renewable (-34 spots to 113). Concurrently, capital is rotating toward defensive pockets, with Grocery Stores and Discount Stores advancing 19 and 16 spots respectively, while precious metals like Gold and Silver flash early fading signals.

## Strength
- **Traditional Energy Leadership:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.980), Oil & Gas Integrated (momentum 0.923), and Oil & Gas E&P (momentum 0.889) are all-green across all timeframes and hold top-tier YTD ranks (2, 7, and 11).
- **Persistent Outperformers:** Marine Shipping (momentum 0.959) and Consumer Electronics (momentum 0.909) remain sustained strong, holding top-36 rankings across 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows.
- **Narrow Breadth:** Only 14 out of 144 industry groups are all-green, with Financial Conglomerates (0.84 momentum) and Insurance - Reinsurance (0.83 momentum) among the few financial spaces maintaining multi-timeframe green status.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Rapid Advancers:** Diagnostics & Research surged +23 spots over the last 5 sessions to rank 49, followed by Insurance - Diversified (+21 spots to 73) and Internet Content & Information (+20 spots to 68).
- **Severe De-rankings:** Coking Coal collapsed 46 spots over 5 sessions to rank 92 (momentum 0.47), while Uranium tumbled 38 spots to rank 105 (momentum 0.21) and Aluminum dropped 36 spots to rank 89 (momentum 0.25).
- **Persistent Momentum Laggards:** Footwear & Accessories anchors the bottom with a 0.047 momentum score (rank 143 YTD), joined by Solar (0.097 momentum, rank 137 YTD) and Utilities - Independent Power Producers (0.099 momentum, rank 139 YTD).

## Divergences
- **Fading High-Momentum Groups:** Biotechnology is experiencing a sharp pullback, shedding 24 spots in 5 sessions despite a 0.68 momentum score. 
- **Metals Losing Ground:** Copper (momentum 0.69, -8 spots in 5d), Gold (momentum 0.68, -5 spots in 5d), and Silver (momentum 0.60, -7 spots in 5d) are showing deteriorating ranks despite previously strong momentum profiles.
- **Emerging Low-Momentum Movers:** Grocery Stores (+19 spots in 5d to rank 100) and Discount Stores (+16 spots in 5d to rank 80) are surging in short-term ranks despite subdued momentum scores of 0.47 and 0.43.
